public.text: The logic model is expected to connect investment to capabilities and outcomes, but it does not explicitly include services, operational adoption, assumptions, risks, or contextual factors.
public.suggestedRevision: Use a complete theory-of-change chain: investment, enabling conditions, components, services, adoption, capabilities, intermediate outcomes, health outcomes, assumptions, risks, and indicators.
